annotations.title: List a contact's email thread with a brand

description:
[read-only] One contact's email with the brand: the threads in the brand's real mailbox, plus what flayr sent them from it with opens, clicks, bounces and the latest reply. Pass the contact as `email`; page with `cursor` and `limit` (1-100).
(Wraps GET /api/v2/brands/{id}/mailbox/threads.)

id.description: A brand id from GET /api/v2/brands. A brand-bound key may only name its own brand (another brand → 403).

name: brand_mailbox_contact_thread
title: List a contact's email thread with a brand
